description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of sentences across different categories within a dataset. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled “Administrative,” “Religion,” “Non-fiction,” “Fiction,” “Law,” “News,” “Science,” and “Ce,” presented in that order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Sentences (K),” represents the number of sentences in thousands, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 902, and tick marks at intervals of 200.  Each category is represented by a single red bar; the “Administrative” category has a bar reaching approximately 525,000 sentences, while “Religion” reaches 190,000 sentences, “Non-fiction” reaches 50,000 sentences, “Fiction” reaches 35,000 sentences, “Law” reaches 23,000 sentences, “News” reaches 110,000 sentences, “Science” reaches 902,000 sentences, and “Ce” reaches 2,000 sentences. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order, and the “Science” bar is visually distinguished by a gray outline.
